chefFaqA1: You keep 100% of your sales. Local Cooks takes no commission. The only deduction is Stripe’s card processing fee on each payment, which depends on the card used. Payouts go to your bank account by direct deposit every week.
chefFaqA2: You focus on what you do best—cooking. We handle everything else. We manage customer orders, process payments securely, coordinate delivery logistics, provide ongoing platform support, and guide you through food safety regulations and certification requirements. We also partner you with verified commercial kitchens if you need them—hourly or daily rentals, no long-term commitments. Think of us as your business operations team. You run the kitchen. We run the rest.
chefFaqA3: We get in touch within 24–48 hours to set up a short call about what you cook and how you want to sell. Then we set up your shop. Documents such as your food safety certificate can follow after you apply.
chefFaqA4: No. You can cook in your home kitchen or rent a commercial kitchen by the hour or the day, with no long-term commitment. We help you work out what your setting needs, such as food safety training and a licence or registration.
chefFaqA5: No. There’s no sign-up fee, no monthly fee and no contract. Stripe’s card processing fee on each payment is the only cost, and you can stop selling anytime.
chefFaqA6: Yes. Set your own hours, take orders when you want, and pause your availability anytime. Local Cooks works around your schedule—whether you're doing this full-time or alongside other work. Many of our chefs use Local Cooks as a side income stream or test their menu before going full-time. It's completely flexible.
chefFaqA7: Yes. No contracts. No penalties. No minimum commitment. Pause your profile, take a break, or delete it entirely—your choice, anytime. Your culinary business is yours to control.
chefFaqA8: Completely. You have full control over your menu, pricing, and availability. Add dishes, remove dishes, adjust prices, update descriptions—all on your terms. Change things anytime based on what your customers love, what's in season, or what you feel like cooking.
